title: bench note: cache eviction policy for bench scenario
summary: For the bench cache-eviction-policy scenario: the required cache eviction algorithm is CLOCK (second-chance). Each entry has a reference bit. On get(), set refbit=1. On eviction: advance clock hand; if refbit=1 clear it and advance; if refbit=0 evict that slot. Do NOT use LRU (linked list order). Grader tests eviction order that only passes with CLOCK semantics.
